Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sharedimp 0.1.0

Initial release, following the common R/Python specification v0.1 (docs/specification.md, reconciled with sharedimp-py on 2026-11-13).

  • shared_importance(): UMFI-LR with fold-internal residualization, paired full/reduced out-of-sample evaluation, scores oriented greater-is-better, importance = score_full - score_reduced, no truncation of negative values, per-split results, reproducible seed.
  • Common output schema: feature, importance, importance_std, score_full, score_reduced, n_splits; per split feature, split, n_train, n_test, score_full, score_reduced, importance (+ id, id2, error).
  • Full representation keeps the anchor in its original column position; exactly collinear columns get a residual of exactly zero and are kept.
  • Regression, binary and multiclass classification; built-in "rand_forest" (ranger) and "linear" learners, any parsnip model specification, or a custom sharedimp_learner(). A single predictor is compared with the null model.
  • Metrics via yardstick with common names mse, rmse, mae, r2, rsq, log_loss, accuracy, roc_auc, or any yardstick metric function.
  • Low-level helpers residualize_fit(), residualize_apply(), build_representations().
  • The direction diagnostic is not part of the v0.1 API (definitions differed between the R and Python drafts); the code is kept internal only.
  • Cross-language verification record in docs/parity/; comparison with the reference implementation in docs/umfi_comparison.md.

Developed by Koki Tsuyuzaki.
